response.rationale: Reach is 5 SD above baseline (strongly flagged) while CPM and OSA z-scores are flat, indicating volume moved without any price or competition response. The own-action confound flag is false, so this is unlikely to be the harness's own prior bid/budget change landing. A large reach surge at unchanged CPM is most consistent with a genuine demand-side shock (expanded query/auction volume) rather than a price/competition shift or self-inflicted artifact; flat CPM slightly tempers confidence since some demand shocks do drag price up.
